claim: Assigned test packet complete: B2a repaired; B2b positive regression intentionally RED. Author evidence only; no independent review or product realization claim.
pass_fail_rule: Full discovery has exactly one assertion failure: B2b staged-source-and-rebuilt-output positive. B2a linked-document proof and B2b stale-index negative pass.

baseline.B2b_positive: AssertionError: 1 != 0; rebuilt output differs from HEAD

verification.command: env -u GIT_INDEX_FILE -u GIT_DIR python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/ci/tests -v

origin_and_escape.B2a: S09T fixture excluded docs/plans; no prior spec source linked repository planning documents. Real linked-document fixture now exercises copier and docs gate.
origin_and_escape.B2b: S09 spec gate compared rebuilt output to HEAD; prior tests committed source edits, omitting correctly regenerated staged pre-commit case. Both staged positive and negative now exercise real Git, uv and pinned builder.

dependencies: Existing vendored template, spec builder, linter, diagram tool, Git, uv, dot, Python unittest and PyYAML; no new dependencies or fake gate/tool output.

preparation.launcher: Real tools/ci/gate.sh executable copied from pinned checkout
preparation.fixtures: Fresh owned temporary Git repos, tracked documents and vendored template
preparation.resources: none: Git and Python/uv CLI subprocesses; no server, driver, browser or long-running engine
preparation.gate_time: Baseline 36 tests 4.617s; candidate 39 tests 7.523s, observed increase 2.906s (single runs, not a performance guarantee).

review.coverage_assist.execution: not_run: assigned Test Implementer; independent reviewer must run OCR delegation; no passing review evidence

deterministic_verification.reverify.execution: not_applicable: Python and shell source behavior; no compiled binary claim

limitations: B2b product repair remains for Product Implementer; gate.sh untouched.
No nested agents, Git config writes, PR, merge or issue mutation.
